decision.reasoning_trace: The selected toothbrushes are a mix of high-rated products from well-known brands like Philips, Oral-B, and Sensodyne, as well as budget-friendly options like Pyhralke. The consideration set prioritizes products with excellent customer reviews, a wide range of features like whitening and plaque control capabilities. Philips Sonicare Original W2 Optimal White Standard Sonic Toothbrush Heads were chosen as the final product due to its excellent customer reviews and ratings.
